title: Bible Story; The big fish Swallows Jonah
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 3 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child narrates Jonah and the big fish (Jonah 1-2) and lists the results of Jonah's disobedience.

floor.question: What did Moses say when God called him?

representations: a map arrow: Nineveh one way, Tarshish the other
steps: List what happened because he disobeyed.
Say what Jonah should have done.
contexts: a child told to do homework who runs to play

board.do: Write: God said go to Nineveh.
Point at the ship going the other way.
Wait for the child to say no, he ran to Tarshish.
Write the results: storm, sea, fish.

misconceptions.ask: What did Jonah do when God told him to go to Nineveh?
misconceptions.repair: Show a map arrow pointing away from Nineveh. Read Jonah 1:3.

misconceptions.ask: Why did the sailors throw Jonah into the sea?
misconceptions.repair: Read Jonah 1:12, 15: Jonah told them, and the sea became calm.

misconceptions.ask: How long was Jonah inside the fish?
misconceptions.repair: Read Jonah 1:17 and count three days and nights on fingers.

misconceptions.ask: What happened to Jonah after three days?
misconceptions.repair: Read Jonah 2:10. God kept Jonah alive.

checks.question: Name a result of Jonah's disobedience.
checks.answer: A storm (thrown into the sea, swallowed by a fish)
